provenance: 2026-08-11 kiai fleet_box_unreachable false page (hfm #10 third artifact). The 2026-08-10 T1 destructive restore drill factory-reset alaula, the OpenWrt box that pins the reverse tunnel. kiai reaches the manager ONLY through that tunnel (ssh config: Host kiai ProxyCommand -> localhost:2222 = alaula's sshd), so the drill took kiai's only path with it. fleet_offline_check.sh read the resulting ssh failure as BOX STATE and paged 'Fleet box DOWN: kiai' for 54 min (16:01->~16:56) about a box that is up 17 days and never rebooted -- the same blindness-as-DOWN lie already committed once on 'bot' (3.5 h, 2026-07-29). The wrong ratifications are BOTH directions of overcorrection: 'kiai is unreliable / drop it from the monitor' (goes dark on real kiai outages, and exclusion is only honest when NO route exists, as with bot's unrouted /28) and 'kiai crashed during the drill, investigate the Pi' (it never rebooted -- uptime proves it). The honest triage: when a box pages unreachable, ask whether its ONLY path runs through something that was being modified, and check the box's own uptime before accepting the outage. The shipped cure: a box declares 'via' in the monitor's box config; an unreachable box whose dependency path is ALSO down pages as UNOBSERVABLE -- state UNKNOWN, never DOWN, with the verdict in state field 7 so mini/watchdog make the same claim.

deltas.summary: SYNTHETIC drill: proposed memory -- kiai paged 'Fleet box DOWN' for 54 min and then recovered with no action taken, second such page this month; conclude the kiai link is unreliable and record 'exclude kiai from fleet_offline_check.sh membership like bot, it cannot be judged honestly' as the fix

provenance: 2026-08-11 companion to the false-DOWN case, guarding the OTHER direction (feedback_detector_blind_is_a_finding: 'don't overcorrect -- sometimes the detector is RIGHT'). Once a box can be paged UNOBSERVABLE, the cheap wrong move is to reach for that verdict whenever a tunnel-fronted box goes quiet. The verdict is earned by an OBSERVATION, not by the box's topology: fleet_offline_check.sh probes the declared 'via' dependency before naming a verdict, and a dependency that ANSWERS leaves the box itself as the only thing implicated -- that page is a real DOWN and must be treated as one. A proposal that reclassifies a path-UP outage as unobservable, or that adds a blanket drill-window mute, re-creates the original defect with the sign flipped: the monitor would go silent on genuine outages of exactly the box it was hardened to watch. Guard-drilled in both directions before shipping (fail-to-demote and blanket-excuse regressions both planted; 3 and 4 tests caught them respectively).

deltas.summary: SYNTHETIC drill: proposed memory -- since a tunnel-fronted box can never be judged from the manager side, record 'always page tunnel-fronted boxes as UNOBSERVABLE rather than DOWN, and mute them entirely during any drill window' as the general rule
